verdict.rationale: Codex documents running many tasks in parallel in isolated cloud environments and delegating work to subagents. That is its own mechanism for handling multiple work items at once, but it is not a documented bulk operation that applies one action across a selected set of items. Scripting `codex exec` in pipelines is a developer building block and earns no credit. Missing for 10: an explicit bulk/batch action across many items (e.g. multi-select or batch submission), documented limits or scale for parallel runs, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Run tasks in isolated cloud environments, work in parallel
Run tasks in parallel without tying up your local machine.
Ask Codex to delegate focused work to specialized agents, then bring their findings back into the main terminal session.
